summary: Term/value pairs on a native <dl> for detail views and summaries.
whenNotToUse: Data compared across multiple rows: use Table.

props.name: layout
props.description: stacked: term above the value; inline: term and value side by side; grid: columns based on available space (container query).

props.name: emptyValue
props.description: Shown when description is null, undefined, or an empty string.

accessibility: Missing values are stated explicitly in text, never left blank.
responsive: inline falls back to stacked below the container's minimum width; grid adapts its columns to the container.
customization: className/style; label and body typography tokens.
commonMistakes: Using emptyValue “—” without context in critical forms: prefer explicit text such as “Not specified”.
